Overview

Semarang is a city in Central Java with a population of 1,653,000. Central Java’s capital and a historic port city with a rich Chinese-Indonesian heritage and culinary scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
